value.rationale: The family with all but two weights equal to one is a natural infinite slice. The theorem converts a many-element singularity test into a two-inequality triangular region in every dimension, gives exact counts and the full canonical/non-terminal boundary, and provides a benchmark for broader classification algorithms.
